summary: The test suite comprehensively covers all major requirements through three complementary approaches: unit tests (CartesianProduct, Excludes, Includes, SizeValidation), workflow structure tests (YAML shape, triggers, job dependencies, permissions), and end-to-end act tests with multiple fixtures. Edge cases are tested (empty axes, partial matches, oversized matrices, missing configs, no-matrix errors). However, the design has a critical fragility: the act test harness relies on a greedy regex `'::set-output:: matrix=(\{.*\})\s*\r?\n'` to extract JSON from multiline output, which would match from the first `{` to the LAST `}` if multiple JSON objects appear—though this works for single-line output, it's brittle. Additionally, unit tests check counts and spot-check combinations (e.g., 2 of 4 combinations verified) but don't validate complete output structure; the New-BuildMatrix tests verify specific exclude/include behavior but don't enumerate all generated matrix cells. The powershell-yaml YAML parser assumes simple YAML structure. Despite these, the suite would catch most regressions through redundant test coverage (failures in core functions cascade to act tests). The three test files are well-organized with clear names and comments; fixtures are external (good), but the fixtures themselves weren't provided for evaluation.
